recent_chronicle.title: CosmoWanda Dispersion Reaches Z=31.3 as Ollama Maintenance Fails
recent_chronicle.blurb: Background research and league maintenance both failed with 500 Internal Server Error responses from the Ollama kimi-k2.6 endpoint. Research still concluded two X% protocol questions—on live infrastructure encoding and discrete increment sizing—while opening new inquiries into warm-start crash recovery and telemetry controller safeguards. Trading telemetry showed acute stress: cosmowanda-top-20 hold_time_dispersion registered repeated extreme divergences up to z=31.3, cosmowanda-top-50 avg_roi diverged at z=9.9, and timmy-top-20 dispersion breached z=9.0. The system knowledge index grew by 53 entries, reaching 336.
